+import json
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+from identity_client import require_api_key
+from identity_models import normalize_email
+
+
+GOOGLE_IDENTITY_TOOLKIT = "https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:signUp"
+
+
+def register_user(email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = require_api_key()
+    payload = {"email": normalize_email(email), "password": password, "returnSecureToken": True}
+    response = requests.post(f"{GOOGLE_IDENTITY_TOOLKIT}?key={api_key}", json=payload, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def handler(event: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    data = event if isinstance(event, dict) else json.loads(event)
+    return register_user(data["email"], data["password"])
